A template with other defaults

Source: R/tpl_company.R
tfl_template_variant.Rd

A company's or a study's template is mostly its defaults: the variables of its demographics table, the severity's levels, the records kept. This registers one by them alone, no R body: from's parameters, types and body, with defaults in place of from's. It is looked up as from is when it runs, so a fix to from reaches it.

Usage

tfl_template_variant(
  name,
  from,
  defaults = list(),
  label = NULL,
  example = NULL,
  ai = NULL,
  hide = NULL
)

Arguments

name

The variant's name. from's own name replaces from (with a message).

from

The template it is a variant of (tfl_templates()).

defaults

Its parameters' defaults, by name: list(variables = c("AGE", "SEX")). Each is one of from's parameters.

label

Its label; NULL: from's.

example

The parameters tfl_test_templates() and its help page's example run it with; NULL: from's.

ai

TRUE to list it in the AI requests that answer with templates (tfl_ai_prepare()(templates = TRUE)); NULL: from's.

hide

Parameters of from that are not the variant's arguments: left out of its help, tfl_templates() and the AI's list, and a report's template: args: may not give them. They keep their defaults and the study standard's values (tfl_param(study = )), as the look of a figure's report type takes the figure style standard's; a report changes that with its own items (+) or plot:.

Value

name, invisibly.

Details

A report's YAML names it (template: {name: demog_jp}); its program (the A use, tfl_content_code()) calls from's function with the variant's defaults written out, so the package that registers it exports nothing. A value comes from, first to last: the report's arguments, the study standard (study.yml, defaults.yml: tfl_param(study = )), the variant's defaults, from's.

Register it where it is used: a company's package's .onLoad() (tfl_use_company_templates()), or a study's spec/templates/*.R.

Examples

tfl_template_variant("demog_age_sex", from = "demog",
                     defaults = list(continuous = "AGE", categorical = "SEX"))
tfl_template_params("demog_age_sex")$categorical$default
#> [1] "SEX"
